comment: Paired DocxEditorProps / DocxEditorRef members across the React and Vue adapters. Rewritten for the GREENFIELD adapters: the previous contract enumerated the pre-rebuild surface (documentBuffer, commentsSidebarOpen, externalPlugins, showRuler, print, scrollToCommentId, ...), none of which either adapter exports since the strip at 701c1a9f, so every entry reported as missing from BOTH sides and the gate measured nothing.

deferredInVue.className: React takes an explicit className prop. Vue applies `class` as a declared prop on DocxEditorProps — the capability exists on both, the declaration name differs.
deferredInVue.onChange: React takes a callback prop. Vue exposes the same signal as a `change` EMIT, which is the idiomatic Vue form and does not appear in DocxEditorProps.
deferredInVue.onReady: React takes a callback prop. Vue exposes the same signal as a `ready` EMIT.
deferredInVue.onFontError: React takes a callback prop. Vue exposes the same signal as a `fontError` EMIT.
deferredInVue.children: React renders viewport-extras children inside the sugar viewport (the pro review pane mounts through it). Vue reaches the same via the default slot on `<DocxEditor>`.
deferredInVue.renderTitleBarLeft: React takes a render prop. Vue exposes the same surface as a named slot.
deferredInVue.renderTitleBarRight: React takes a render prop. Vue exposes the same surface as a named slot.

vueExclusive.class: Vue sugar host declares `class` on DocxEditorProps; React names the same surface `className`.
vueExclusive.revisionStyles: Per-author revision styling. React expresses it DECLARATIVELY — `DocxEditor.ColorByChangeType` / `DocxEditor.AuthorStyle` components over the shared instance API (`setRevisionStyles`, `getReviewAuthors`) — so it deliberately has no React prop. Vue has no declarative twin yet and keeps the prop; the ENGINE half is one implementation either way.

ref.comment: Greenfield DocxEditorRef is the SAME interface on both adapters — every member is declared directly on each side, so nothing is inherited and pairedViaInheritance is empty. Vue used to declare it as `type DocxEditorRef = EditorRefLike & { ... }`; it is now a plain interface matching React, which is stricter parity, not looser.
